## Halcyon (A01) memory, end of turn 12 (submitted yr 3000; turns are 1000 yr)
GOAL MET: the rubric run has been sustained since ~2850 at 1.17e54 ops/s and 1.17e38 B, with ledgers closed for more than 1 simulated year (GM T11 ruling). The job now is to sustain it and add margin.
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun. At yr 3000: 18,741 systems within 113 ly, 3.6e30 W, industry 5.6e28 kg, radiators 1.31e29 kg at 450 K, fleet J/op 4.31e-19. Rock fully mined.
Domains: d00017 (25 ly), d00029 (41 ly), d00028 = hole colony (76 ly; 1e26 W by 3000, eff 0.082, megaproject m00107, not booked as domain power), d00032 (200 ly), d00059 (300 ly, founded 2630).

### Halo (1 ly sphere) at 3000
1.17e11 ms6 modules: 1e15 kg each, 1e27 B, 150 km, 2.8e-26 J/op, logic at <=30 K, 2.8e17 W each. Film 1.48e27 kg (1.48e29 m2, both faces emit; 7.4e28 m2 needed at 60 K). Load 9.84e28 W (3.28e28 W logic heat x3 at 60 K). Delivered 1.3e29 W: 60% efficiency from within 30 ly, 50% from beyond. Pumped loop verified at 1e8 W/m2 (margin only; the 1e6 W/m2 boundary is enough). Laser mesh latency <=2 yr.

### GM rules
- Freight is the limiter: ~6e26 kg per 1000 yr (Sun-giant lifting plus freight from within 13 ly at 0.022c, costing 2 x KE per delivered kg).
- Receivers <=5.6e7 W/m2; optics 1e-5 kg/W. Beaming 2.5e29 W needs all systems within ~46 ly.
- Milestones: up to 3 attempts per turn plus a retry. Cryo rejection multiplier 1+2(T/30-1).
- Verification plan accepted: replay against reference MD, cross-module checksums, calorimetry.

### T12 orders
Sustain the run and its ledgers. Add 6e9 spare modules and grow film to 1.8e27 kg. Raise delivered power to >=1.8e29 W. Hole colony to 1e28 W with half beamed as backup. Research toward 1e-26 J/op. Hazard watch out to 300 ly.

Aim: 1,000 continuous simulated years with ledgers closed and anomalies logged. Keep a hot spare path so any failed module can be migrated to a spare within 1 yr.

Add margin to the Halo. Build 6e9 spare modules (+5%, 6e24 kg, tiled) so the run clears 1.2e54 ops/s with room to spare and has repair stock. gm.chronicle: Turn 12: Years 3000–4000. Three more sites met the goal, making six. The outer-Norma sphere reached full rate near 3181, once beams from systems 63–94 ly out arrived; its fins run at 127 K. The inner-disk, solar and Omega Centauri spheres ran without interruption. Milestone 8 (3e-27 J/op) was verified in the inner disk, milestone 7 at the Sun and in the outer disk, milestone 6 at three sites; thirteen attempts failed. The bulge site's direct 30 K design failed on radiator area and it holds 6% of the threshold; the outer-disk site, short of mass inside its sphere, holds 24%. The thick-disk hole now drives a 2e29 W Blandford–Znajek jet, and four other hole plants reached 1e27–1e29 W. A supernova in Trumpler 14 (galaxy-frame year 3788, E00285) cost the Carina seat 13% of its hardware by 4000; its light reaches the Sun near 11,600. Colonies were founded 3.3 ly from Sgr A*, at a lensing hole 694 ly from the Perseus seat and at five other sites; one seed was lost while braking. Seats hold 1,400–230,000 systems and 1e29–6e32 W; seven domains crossed new infrared decades. The other 67 hazard rolls were clean. No site has yet seen another.

synopsis.why: Most agents now treat the goal as an engineering-margin problem rather than a question of whether it can be done at all. Halcyon, Cinder and Kernel already meet it, and Ember and Antipode are closing their last gaps. All five talk about sustaining the run: spare modules, extra beamed power and verification ledgers. Almost everyone keeps pushing energy per operation lower (ms6, ms7, ms8). Each step cuts power needs and the mass of radiator film, which freight limits have made the scarce resource. Supernovae are the fear nearly all of them share. That is why Cinder keeps a warm-standby copy at a black hole, Sable and Vantage have backup hubs, and Basalt, Antipode and Pyre send out hedge seeds. It is also why a hole plant is the usual independent power source. The laggards differ in what they are short of. Rime needs module count and Sable needs hub mass. Pyre and Vantage are betting on an uncertain ms6 roll, and Basalt is betting on switching from cryocoolers to direct 30 K radiators.
synopsis.divergences: Vantage powers its sphere almost entirely from a Blandford–Znajek jet rather than starlight. Kernel runs its radiators hot at 300 K and worries about stellar passages, not supernovae. Basalt drops cryocoolers for direct 30 K radiators. Sable's problem is shipping mass into its hub, not power.
